faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BHU Field Investigator position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Field Investigator post at Banaras Hindu University is 27th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Investigator role?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate degree in any Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks. A preference will be given to those with a four-year graduation program.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Field Investigator position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Field Investigator post is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government norms for specific categories.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the BHU Field Investigator recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Field Investigator recruitment at BHU. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Field Investigator position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Field Investigator role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Field Investigator position at BHU primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the BHU Field Investigator recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Field Investigator post announced by Banaras Hindu University in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Field Investigator position at Banaras Hindu University is a contractual job. The appointment will be on a contract basis.
